positions.name: PallasineChecklistAuthority
positions.frame: what establishes the Pallasine checklist as the current, authoritative onboarding process for new hires?
positions.why: Both segments carry the relational authority-ranking read: src-1 states the checklist as a uniform mandate every new hire completes (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift), and src-2 supplies the provenance that makes that mandate current — it formally superseded the old wiki page last quarter. Read together they answer not just what the process is but why it now holds institutional force; there is a mild conviction gradient (src-1 lands as settled decision, src-2 as a supporting factual claim) but both point the same direction — establishing legitimacy through mandate plus supersession, not just describing steps.
